blurb: Colton Golf Club is unique, because it was designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr. a renowned golf course architect. At one time, legendary professional Sam Snead was part owner and played here, whenever he was in town. The course has a real nice layout providing a challenge for even low-handicapper, rewards accuracy more than distance and provides the beginner the perfect way to learn the game of golf.
